mercy_translation.text:
Let everyone who comes in the name of the Lord be received. Afterward, test him and you will know him, for you will have discernment between right and left.

If the one who comes is a traveler, help him as much as you can. He shall not remain with you more than two or three days, if necessary.

If he wishes to settle among you and is a craftsman, let him work and eat. If he has no trade, provide according to your understanding so that no Christian lives among you in idleness.

If he refuses to do this, he is making merchandise out of Christ. Beware of such people.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
χριστέμπορος is rendered idiomatically as someone 'making merchandise out of Christ'—a profiteer from Christian identity.
